subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: The Trebuchet: Siege Engineering
description: A fast breakdown of The Trebuchet: Siege Engineering for builders.

hook.text: A heavy weight drops and a stone flies 300 meters. Pure leverage.

buildup.text: A long arm pivots on an axle. The short end holds a counterweight.

discovery.text: When released, the weight swings down and the long arm whips the stone out.

twist.text: A sling at the tip adds range by extending the arm's effective length.

climax.text: The trebuchet could hurl 100 kg stones and outranged any earlier siege weapon.

punchline.text: Gravity, leverage, and a sling — medieval artillery in three parts.

quiz.question: What provides the energy to launch a trebuchet's projectile?
options: Soldiers pulling ropes to swing the arm
A falling counterweight converts gravitational energy into launch force
Twisted ropes store torsion energy and release it suddenly
